title: Julia Child birinchi kitobini 49 yoshida chiqargan

scenes.text: Julia Child birinchi kitobini 1961 yilda, 49 yoshida chiqardi.
Pazandachilikni u Parijda 37 yoshida, 1949 yilda o'rgana boshlagan.
Ikki hamkori bilan yillar davomida retseptlar ustida ishladi.
1963 yilda u televideniyeda o'z pazandachilik ko'rsatuvini boshladi.
scenes.keywords: chef cooking in front of camera

scenes.text: Boshlash uchun to'g'ri yoshni kutish shart emas.

description: Julia Childning birinchi kitobi Mastering the Art of French Cooking 1961 yilda, u 49 yoshda bo'lganida chiqdi. U pazandachilikni Parijdagi Le Cordon Bleu maktabida 1949 yilda o'rgana boshlagan va 1963 yilda The French Chef ko'rsatuvini boshlagan. Sen nimani yoshim o'tdi deb ortga surib yuribsan?
source: Julia Child Foundation: timeline (Le Cordon Bleu enrolment 1949), https://juliachildfoundation.org/?p=69 ; Wikipedia: Mastering the Art of French Cooking (Knopf, 1961; Child, Simone Beck, Louisette Bertholle), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mastering_the_Art_of_French_Cooking ; Tasting Table: At 49, Julia Child launched a life-changing cookbook, https://www.tastingtable.com/2187447/julia-child-mastering-the-art-of-french-cooking-legacy/ . Note: Child was born 15 Aug 1912, so 49 at the 1961 publication and 37 in 1949; The French Chef debuted nationally in February 1963 (local pilots in 1962).
